title: Mock Interviews
definition: The most important part of prep. Solving a problem silently is completely different from solving it while explaining your time/space complexity aloud to an engineer over a video call.
simpleExplanation: Practicing talking out loud while you code.

answers.question: **Basic:** Describe the fundamental approach for Mock Interviews.
**Intermediate 1:** Add Memoization (Top-Down) to Mock Interviews to prevent redundant calculations.
**Intermediate 2:** Convert Mock Interviews into a Tabulation (Bottom-Up) approach.
**Advanced:** Solve a 2D matrix or multi-state problem using Mock Interviews.
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize the space complexity of Mock Interviews from O(N) to O(1) or O(N^2) to O(N).
